opening.argument: The presentation identifies Forsage as a platform to join and ties earning to both the viewer's work and work connected to other participants. The narration states, “you will earn money from your work but you also get money from your work,” while the displayed references to an upline working and a team working visually place earnings within a participant-linked structure. This is consistent with a recruitment-based, tiered matrix in which personal and team activity are presented as the route to money. The speaker then directs interested viewers to continue privately, stating, “you can message us by calling the number on your address.” The available evidence does not establish any fee, payment, or financial outcome, but it does establish the earning and contact pitch around the Forsage platform.
